verdict.rationale: Jules can be driven programmatically through its API to 'automate tasks like bug fixing', can open PRs automatically via the optional automationMode field, and can be assigned tasks through a GitHub issue label. A team could therefore build its own pipeline that feeds security alerts to Jules and gets fix PRs back. Nothing in the evidence shows native security-alert intake or any validation of alerts, so this only works with custom glue code. Missing for 10: native security-alert integration, automated alert validation/triage, documented security-remediation workflow, independent corroboration of security fixes.
